items.title: Carmen Lundy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 15, 2023
items.q: And I love the way, if you think about it, Ella Fitzgerald on that famous “How High the Moon” she goes [sings] “I guess if you were wondering what I’m singing.”

ctx.x: Yeah that makes people put their drink down and go, “Wait a minute” —

“Wait a second. It doesn’t go like that.” And I love the way, if you think about it, Ella Fitzgerald on that famous “How High the Moon” she goes [sings] “I guess if you were wondering what I’m singing.” You know what I mean?
Yeah she got through the whole “Mac the Knife” without I think singing any of the original lyric except maybe the title. That takes some nerve.
